notes: Cash basis county. Statement receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); roll-forward 18,109,741 + 16,937,872 - 18,574,533 + 4,321,909 - 4,321,909 = 16,473,080 ties. Taxes 8,301,126 split using Statement of Activities general receipts (p2: Property 7,164,668 + Motor vehicle 682,311 + Lodging 454,147 = 8,301,126, exact; Inheritance is its own p4 line). Unlike FY2023/FY2024, Local 1,441,108 is NOT split: SoA charges for services 1,213,171 + interest income 58,716 + miscellaneous 165,146 = 1,437,033 (4,075 short; the SoA program receipts also include part of Intergovernmental), so it stays one context line (other). Debt service 'Principal and interest' kept combined as printed on p4. Fund balances from p4; ending_cash left null as in FY2023-FY2025 (p3 prints Cash 9,101,899 and Restricted cash 7,371,181, recorded on the balance sheet). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement p3 (totals equal the government-wide p1). Detail: General Fund column from the budgetary comparison schedule p14 (department lines, not itemized; its Taxes 6,750,452 = combining-page General Fund Taxes 6,724,887 + Inheritance tax 25,565); other General Fund sub-fund columns (Reappraisal Sinking, Inheritance Tax, County Medical Relief, State Institutions, Veteran's Aid) from the combining pages p5-6; Road Fund and Highway Allocation Capital Projects Fund from their budget schedules p15-16 (Road Fund single disbursements line split into public works/capital outlay from its p4 statement column, as FY2023); nonmajor funds per fund column from the combining pages p7-13 (COVID American Rescue Plan Fund is a nonmajor fund this year, no budget schedule). Fund-level taxes not split except visitors funds (lodging: SoA Lodging 454,147 = the two visitors funds' Taxes). Read pages 1-16 of 16
